facts.summary: An authorized PDS administrator can review and manage complaints submitted through the applicable PDS complaint-management system.
management_operations: Assign or forward complaints to the appropriate authority or responsible person when supported by the system.
Record resolution or action taken when supported by the system.
how_to_access: Log in using the authorized administrator account.
Open the complaint or grievance management section.
Select the complaint that requires review.
Review the available complaint details and current status.
Take the authorized action and update the complaint record when applicable.
complaint_information: Customer or beneficiary information available to the administrator.
Complaint category or type where supported.
Action or resolution information recorded in the system.
facts.status_management: An authorized administrator may update complaint status according to the workflow and permissions of the applicable PDS system.
facts.resolution: Complaint resolution depends on the nature of the complaint, verification performed and the applicable administrative procedure.
facts.escalation: Complaints that require further action may be forwarded or escalated according to the applicable State/UT grievance procedure and system workflow.
facts.access_control: Complaint information should only be accessed and modified by authorized administrative users.
facts.privacy: Complaint records may contain beneficiary or other personal information and should be handled only for legitimate administrative purposes.
facts.state_specific: The complaint categories, statuses, assignment process, escalation workflow and available administrative actions can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Only authorized administrators should manage complaint records.
Do not close or mark a complaint as resolved without appropriate action or verification.
Do not assume that every administrator has permission to modify complaint status.
Do not expose complaint or beneficiary information to unauthorized users.
The exact complaint workflow depends on the applicable PDS system.

faqs.question: Can an admin manage customer complaints?
faqs.answer: An authorized PDS administrator can review and manage complaints through the applicable complaint-management system.

faqs.question: What can an admin do with a complaint?
faqs.answer: Depending on permissions, an administrator may view complaint details, check status, assign or forward complaints, update status and record resolution or action taken.

faqs.question: How can an admin view complaints?
faqs.answer: Log in using the authorized administrator account and open the complaint or grievance management section.

faqs.question: Can an admin change complaint status?
faqs.answer: An authorized administrator may update complaint status according to the workflow and permissions provided by the applicable PDS system.

faqs.question: Can an admin escalate a complaint?
faqs.answer: A complaint may be forwarded or escalated when required, according to the applicable State/UT grievance procedure and system workflow.

faqs.question: When should a complaint be marked resolved?
faqs.answer: A complaint should be marked resolved only after the appropriate action or verification has been completed according to the applicable procedure.
